core_obligations: Retain general cocharacter data and nonsplit/general parabolic scope; finite possibly nonsmooth stabilizer and norm q-power.
Reduce extension to all root-boundary curves; retain explicit Frobenius-twisted unipotent factorization.
Remove unipotent terms by highest-weight invariance and prove both-sided Borel valuation invariance through dominant rational cocharacter.
Compute finite Bruhat-cell valuation multiplicities and Frobenius-orbit weighted sum, preserving iff and all simple-root inequalities.
proof_roadmap: Norm as a section on the ordinary locus.
Highest-weight invariance and double-Borel-coset valuation invariance.
Bruhat cardinalities and rational cocharacter orbit sum.
difficulty_reason: The retained proof handles parabolics not defined over the finite field: explicit root SL2 boundary curves and Frobenius-twisted unipotent factors are converted into a valuation computation, highest-weight invariance removes the new factors, and dominance of a rational cocharacter proves double-Borel-coset invariance before finite Bruhat cardinalities yield the exact Frobenius-orbit weighted inequalities. This connected geometric and representation-theoretic construction is the nonroutine core; neither the final criterion alone nor the terminology supplies the difficulty.
difficulty_assessment_limits: H2 supported; H3 not asserted. Earlier boundary factorization and finite Bruhat results are attributed external tools. No independent correctness certification.
